blurb: As the largest waterfront event venue in Manhattan, Pier Sixty offers 20,000 square feet of column-free space on the Hudson River at Chelsea Piers. Floor-to-ceiling windows run the length of the room and open onto a glass-enclosed all-season terrace and the outdoor Veranda beyond, so the river reads as part of the room rather than a view from it.
